title: Sword Art Online's Echoes of Aincrad Game Previews 'Unanswered//butterfly' Bonus Anime
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment began streaming a new trailer for Echoes of Aincrad , the new action RPG based on Reki Kawahara 's Sword Art Online franchise, on Monday. The trailer previews the game's bundled "Unanswered//butterfly" bonus special promotional anime.
author: ANN

title: Eren the Southpaw Anime Casts Natsumi Fujiwara
content: The staff for the television anime of Kappi and nifuni 's Hidarikiki no Eren ( Eren the Southpaw ) manga announced on Monday that Natsumi Fujiwara plays Akari Kishi's manager Sachiyo Saitō. Saitō appears in episode 6 of the series, which airs on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo’s Artist Unveils New Look At Beloved Characters
content: Warning: This article contains spoilers from the Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo manga! The sequel manga series, Jujutsu Kaisen Modulo , written by Gege Akutami and illustrated by Yuji Iwasaki, reached its conclusion in March 2026.

title: The One Piece Anime Remake to Reveal Sneak Peek on June 23, 2026 at Annecy
content: Netflix has confirmed its upcoming slate for the Annecy International Animation Film Festival, with a sneak peek at the remake anime series The One Piece scheduled for June 23, 2026.

content: The Spring 2026 anime schedule has been packed with a ton of shows , and here are a few hidden gems that have gone under the radar so far. It’s been such a jam packed year for new anime releases that it can feel impossible to keep up with everything.

title: Solo Leveling Season 3 Gets Promising Update on Its Future Release
content: Solo Leveling is now in the works on what’s coming next for the anime, and the producer behind it all has shared a promising update on its future return for Season 3. Solo Leveling has been one of the major breakout hits of the last few years as its first two seasons were an immediate hit with fans.

title: Regular Show Revival Premiere Reveals How It Continues From Cartoon Network Classic
content: Regular Show has officially returned to Cartoon Network with the premiere of a brand new revival series, and the first episode of Regular Show: The Lost Tapes explains how it picks up all these years after the original series.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries’ Latest Release Is a Major Hit Even Before Its Debut
content: The Apothecary Diaries is returning this year with a Season 3 and an original feature film. The upcoming season will be released in two cours and the first one will premiere in October this year, while the second cour is scheduled for Spring 2024.
